title: MULTILEADER whole-operation revision allocation transaction matrix
scope: Locally generated DXF whole-operation transaction evidence for one text-content MULTILEADER with a nested root and leader line, across the minimum supported revision and later admitted targets.

profile.content: Text content, overall scale, non-default landing/arrow sizes, one root attachment and one two-point leader line with non-default indices.

checks: Whole-operation allocation failures preserve a pre-existing sentinel destination and every checked caller-model field; same-codec retry reproduces clean bytes and fresh typed MLEADER readback.
The allocation sweep includes a terminal no-failure boundary probe and verifies that it produces the clean reference bytes; only actually injected failures are counted.
AC1018 target refusal preserves caller and destination; the same codec retries successfully at AC1021 in ASCII and Binary with typed readback.
Generated output is removed after each lane; no DWG/DXF fixture is added.
verification.directResult: PASS, eight revision/encoding cells and AC1018 refusal/AC1021 same-codec retry in ASCII and Binary

limitations: Generated writer and same-library typed readback only; no independent producer or reader qualification.
This one text-content/root/line profile does not prove all MULTILEADER content branches, style dependency closure, native rendering, or 3D consumer semantics.
